#!/bin/bash
function minio_tool() {
    while true
    do
      course=`netstat -anp |grep 127.0.0.1:9000`
      if [ -n "$course" ]; then
        sh -c /opt/minio/mc_local.sh
        mc anonymous set private data/
        break
      else
        sleep 30s
      fi
    done
}

minio_tool

#集群节点数量
NODES="1"
#数据存放目录
MINIO_VOLUMES="/opt/minio/data"
#端口号设置
SERVER_PORT="9000"
CONSOLER_PORT="9001"
#用户名
MINIO_ROOT_USER="admin"
#密码
MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD="kedacom123"
